heterogeneity_flagged: KEY FINDING #1 (mirror-image of Finance): Population is the OPPOSITE pattern to Finance. Finance had all 6 issues pass the incomplete-circuit test but 1 issue (FRAUD_SCANDAL) fell OUTSIDE the 9-class failure taxonomy (adversarial/deception). Population is the reverse: ALL 5 issues MAP cleanly to the E/I-dynamics taxonomy (no adversarial/information-integrity archetype anywhere in Population), BUT one issue (POPULATION_COLLAPSE) FAILS the incomplete-circuit test — its circuit carries no regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner at all.

POPULATION_COLLAPSE — this is the ONLY issue across Energy/Finance/Population whose authored circuit is INCOMPLETE (no REGULATORY_NODES member present). Its circuit [OXY, SEPT, M1, RAPHE, VTA, RSC] is six pure driver/effector/limbic nodes with no brake, no feedback sensor, no extinction arm. Under Part XIV this is the incomplete-circuit archetype in the flesh: a collapse circuit with its own regulatory arm omitted. The failure-class (NEURODEGENERATION) and the incomplete-circuit verdict co-point: a below-replacement, regulator-less atrophy loop.

POPULATION_COLLAPSE structural note: unlike the other 4 issues it has NO _canonical single-node circuit and NO _authored/resolved block — its 'circuits' array IS its authored circuit (older schema). The JS falls back to issue.circuits, so those 6 nodes are what the test sees.

MASS_MIGRATION — classed GATING_FAILURE (flood) on the _authored circuit (influx exceeding processing/absorption capacity). Its canonical single-node cue (CeA 'phasic fear output — hair-trigger=false-alarm') points instead at a salience false-alarm flavor. Node-vs-authored divergence recorded, not resolved by guessing (same shape as Finance SYSTEMIC_CONTAGION).

AGING_CRISIS — classed EXCITOTOXICITY on the dominant authored cue (demand exploding with failed clearance -> insolvency/death). Its canonical single-node cue (GP 'basal-ganglia output gate — flood') points at a gating-flood flavor. Divergence recorded.

MASS_MIGRATION and URBANIZATION_OVERLOAD both -> GATING_FAILURE (flood), grounded on different cues (migration influx vs THAL 'stuck-open=flood'); same two-of-a-kind pattern Finance had with its two GATING_FAILUREs (BANKING_CRISIS, CREDIT_FREEZE).
_meta.honesty_note: Mechanisms, failure-mode classes, parameters, and references below are verbatim-grounded in the source document. Per-node / per-edge Population-specific assignments the document gives no basis for (which edge is which inhibitory motif, which oscillatory band, which neuromodulator, which predictive direction) are NOT guessed here; only the two operations the source document directly supports are performed: (1) classify each authored issue against the Part XIV failure taxonomy where the issue's own text names a matching mechanism, and (2) run the Part XIV incomplete-circuit test.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Excitation/inhibition (E/I) balance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Inhibition tracks excitation on a millisecond timescale; balance sets gain, dynamic range, timing precision, and stability. Loss of inhibition -> runaway (seizure); excess -> silence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Any faithful mapping must have inhibition/brakes that SCALE WITH DRIVE.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Four inhibitory motifs
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: feedforward (narrow temporal window / coincidence), feedback/recurrent (self-limiting, gain control, stability), lateral (contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening), disinhibition (inhibiting an inhibitor = permissive gating/selection).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: All four are reused at every scale; their absence breaks the fractal.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Oscillations & communication-through-coherence
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Rhythms create periodic windows of excitability; groups that oscillate coherently open input/output windows at the same time and communicate; incoherent groups are functionally disconnected. Bands: delta 1-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12, beta 13-30, gamma 30-80+ Hz.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Coherence = a dynamic routing/connection switch. There is an OPTIMAL coupling band; too-strong and too-weak coupling both fail.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Thalamocortical gating
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Thalamus + TRN gate what reaches cortex; tonic (faithful relay) vs burst (detection/alerting) modes under corticothalamic top-down control.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Gating must occur AT THE RIGHT STAGE - filter too early (before the circuit that needs the signal) and you lose information you cannot recover.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Predictive coding / prediction error
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hierarchical generative machine: top-down predictions descend, bottom-up prediction ERRORS ascend, only the mismatch propagates upward. Laminar correlate: forward = error, backward = prediction.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: 'Prediction error drives update' must also GENERATE predictions at the mapped scale, not merely react.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Plasticity / learning rules
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Hebbian (correlated -> strengthen); STDP (pre-before-post ~+10 ms -> LTP, post-before-pre -> LTD; dopamine extends LTP window to ~+30 ms); LTP/LTD (NMDA/Ca2+); homeostatic scaling (global normalization keeping drive in range so Hebbian learning does not run away); metaplasticity (threshold for change adapts).
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A stabilizing counter-process (homeostatic scaling) MUST counter positive-feedback Hebbian learning, or the system runs away.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Neuromodulation & gain
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Diffuse systems (DA, NE, 5-HT, ACh) carry no detailed content; they set global regime - gain, signal-to-noise, exploration/exploitation, learning rate, arousal. A small modulatory signal reconfigures the whole network's operating point.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A small broadcast signal must be able to rescale the whole system's operating point (one-to-many, multiplicative).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Population & attractor dynamics
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Information lives in distributed population activity, not single cells; sparse coding is efficient/separable; attractor dynamics implement stable states and transitions. Over-gating, over-synchrony, or lost inhibition suppress emergence.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Emergence requires distributed, sparse, inhibition-balanced activity; do not concentrate all state in one node.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Sleep, homeostasis & offline processing
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Sleep down-scales synapses globally while consolidating select memories, and drives glymphatic clearance of waste.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A mandatory OFFLINE maintenance/reset phase - a system with no downtime accumulates damage.

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Signal termination / clearance
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Reuptake, enzymatic degradation, and diffusion bound signal persistence; termination is as important as release and prevents excitotoxic accumulation.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: Clearance/termination must bound signal persistence; a signal that isn't cleared becomes toxic (see failure mode EXCITOTOXICITY).

fractal_critical_mechanisms.name: Refractoriness / dead-time rate limiter
fractal_critical_mechanisms.definition: Absolute refractory period (~1-2 ms) after an action prevents a second action; enforces one-way propagation and caps maximum firing rate.
fractal_critical_mechanisms.design_invariant: A built-in rate limiter / dead-time after action must exist to cap throughput and enforce directionality.

inhibitory_motifs_catalog.definition: Input excites both a target and an interneuron that inhibits the target -> narrow temporal window (coincidence-detection, AND within a time window).
Output feeds back through interneurons -> self-limiting, gain control, stability.
Active units suppress neighbors -> contrast enhancement, winner-take-all, sparsening.
Inhibiting an inhibitor -> permissive gating / selection.

failure_modes.definition: E/I balance failure: runaway recurrent excitation when inhibition is insufficient. Archetypal no-brakes -> runaway.
Excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit.
A slow wave of depolarization then silence; homeostatic overwhelm.
Thalamocortical/TRN gating breakdown: too little filtering -> flooding, or mis-timed gating -> wrong information passed; gate stuck closed -> starvation.
Losing the inhibitor releases pathological activity (loss of the stop/brake).
Over-coupling (hypersynchrony) or under-coupling; both degrade communication.
Aggregation + failed clearance + network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time.
Losing input disables not just the lesioned node but distant connected regions. THE NETWORK, NOT THE NODE, IS THE UNIT OF FAILURE; failures propagate across the graph.

A circuit built without its regulatory partner is intrinsically dysfunctional (fear acquisition without extinction; excitation without matched inhibition; feedback without the sensor). THE DIRECT DIAGNOSTIC FOR A BROKEN FRACTAL MAPPING: if the mapping omits the inhibitory/feedback/extinction arm, it is lesioned in the same way a brain is.

issue_failure_class_map._basis: GROUNDED: each mapping uses the Population issue's OWN text (canonical circuit detail and/or _authored detail and/or summary, quoted in population_text) plus the document's Part XIV named class. No new class was invented. Where an issue text names a mechanism with no analog among the 9 classes it would be marked UNMAPPED rather than force-fit — but Population contains no such issue: all 5 are dynamical E/I-type failures.

POPULATION_COLLAPSE.subtype: maintenance/regeneration failure compounding over time -> network collapse
POPULATION_COLLAPSE.population_text: summary: "Fertility rates far below replacement — labor force shrinking, dependency ratios inverting, economic contraction looming"; circuit details: OXY[Hypo] "Birth rates plummeting below 1.5 TFR", M1[Hypo-staffed] "Labor force shrinking", VTA[Hypo] "Youth cohort shrinking", RSC[Hypo-populated] "Rural regions depopulating fastest — entire communities disappearing within a generation"
POPULATION_COLLAPSE.reasoning: The dominant, repeated mechanism is progressive attrition/atrophy with FAILED REGENERATION (fertility below replacement = maintenance/replacement failure) compounding over generations, ending in network collapse (labor force shrinking, communities disappearing). That is the NEURODEGENERATION archetype: 'network collapse; maintenance failure compounding over time', invariant SLEEP_OFFLINE/TERMINATION_CLEARANCE. This is the closest — and the ONLY apt — dynamical class for a below-replacement decline loop.
POPULATION_COLLAPSE.note: PARTIAL FIT flagged honestly: NEURODEGENERATION's 'aggregation + failed clearance' sub-mechanism is ABSENT (population collapse is atrophy/under-drive, not toxic accumulation). Grounded on the 'network collapse + maintenance failure compounding over time' half only. NOT marked UNMAPPED, because the collapse-over-time archetype IS represented in the taxonomy; the aggregation clause simply does not apply.
POPULATION_COLLAPSE.co_finding: This is ALSO the one issue that FAILS the incomplete_circuit_diagnostic below (no regulatory partner in its circuit). The two diagnostics co-point: a regulator-less atrophy loop is both a NEURODEGENERATION-flavored collapse AND a structurally incomplete circuit.

MASS_MIGRATION.population_text: _authored circuit VEST[Hyper] "Migration flows exceeding institutional processing capacity — millions in transit without legal status"; dlPFC[Hyper-stressed] "Urban planning systems unable to absorb rapid population influx"; summary: "unprecedented population movements across borders". canonical circuit CeA[Hyper]: "phasic fear output — hair-trigger=false-alarm"
MASS_MIGRATION.reasoning: The dominant mechanism is an INFLUX exceeding the border/institution's processing and absorption capacity — the units flood through faster than the gate can filter/absorb. That is GATING_FAILURE (too little filtering -> flooding), with the border/asylum system as the overwhelmed gate.
MASS_MIGRATION.note: Classed on the _authored circuit. The canonical single-node cue CeA 'hair-trigger=false-alarm' points instead at a salience false-alarm flavor (a different archetype); this node-vs-authored divergence is flagged, not resolved by guessing. Same divergence shape as Finance SYSTEMIC_CONTAGION.

AGING_CRISIS.subtype: excessive demand with failed clearance -> overload -> death of the unit (insolvency)
AGING_CRISIS.population_text: _authored circuit RAPHE[Hyper-burdened] "Elder population growing faster than caregiving capacity — dementia, chronic disease, and long-term care demand exploding"; CARD[Hyper-stressed] "healthcare costs spiraling"; summary: "healthcare, pension, and caregiving systems approaching insolvency". canonical circuit GP[Hyper]: "basal-ganglia output gate — flood"
AGING_CRISIS.reasoning: The dominant mechanism is EXCESSIVE demand (elder-care load exploding) that the clearance/caregiving capacity cannot terminate, driving the units to overload and death (systems approaching insolvency). That is the EXCITOTOXICITY archetype: 'excessive drive with failed termination/clearance -> overload -> death of the unit', invariant TERMINATION_CLEARANCE.
AGING_CRISIS.note: Classed on the dominant _authored/summary cue (demand exploding -> insolvency). The canonical single-node cue GP 'basal-ganglia output gate — flood' points at a gating-flood flavor; divergence flagged. Both are excess-load failures; EXCITOTOXICITY captures the overload-to-death outcome the summary names.

URBANIZATION_OVERLOAD.population_text: canonical circuit THAL[Hyper]: "gating relay / routing — stuck-open=flood"; _authored AI[Hyper] "Population density exceeding livability thresholds"; RSC[Hypo] "Rural-to-urban migration hollowing out source communities while overloading destination cities"; summary: "Megacities growing beyond infrastructure capacity — housing crisis, transit collapse"
URBANIZATION_OVERLOAD.reasoning: The canonical node cue names the class VERBATIM: 'gating relay / routing — stuck-open=flood'. The city's infrastructure gate is stuck open, flooding destination cities beyond capacity = GATING_FAILURE (too little filtering / stuck-open -> flooding). Strongest node-cue grounding of the set (canonical and _authored agree on flood).
URBANIZATION_OVERLOAD.note: Pairs with MASS_MIGRATION as the second GATING_FAILURE (flood) in Population, grounded on a different cue — the same two-of-a-kind pattern Finance had (BANKING_CRISIS + CREDIT_FREEZE, both GATING_FAILURE).

PANDEMIC_DEMOGRAPHIC_SHOCK.subtype: homeostatic set-point severed -> runaway (loss of the negative-feedback brake)
PANDEMIC_DEMOGRAPHIC_SHOCK.population_text: canonical circuit HYPO[Hyper]: "homeostatic set-point — severed=runaway"; _authored CARD[Hyper-stressed] "Excess mortality overwhelming vital statistics — life expectancy dropping for first time in decades"; AI[Hyper] "Population density identified as primary transmission risk — crowded housing and transit amplifying spread"; summary: "sudden mortality spikes, fertility disruption, and population displacement"
PANDEMIC_DEMOGRAPHIC_SHOCK.reasoning: The canonical node cue names the mechanism VERBATIM: 'homeostatic set-point — severed=runaway'. Severing a homeostatic set-point removes the negative-feedback brake and releases runaway activity — the DISINHIBITION_SYNDROME definition (loss of the stop/brake). Matches the issue's resolved motif M3 (homeostatic set-point) and mirrors Finance CURRENCY_COLLAPSE (vmPFC 'brake-fail=rogue' -> DISINHIBITION).
PANDEMIC_DEMOGRAPHIC_SHOCK.note: The _authored circuit also carries a SEIZURE-adjacent element (AI 'amplifying spread' = recurrent runaway). Classed DISINHIBITION on the governing HYPO cue (a SPECIFIC severed feedback controller), which is a cleaner grounding than generic recurrent-excitation SEIZURE; the spread element is flagged, not force-merged.

incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._test: Part XIV: does each issue's authored circuit contain a regulatory/inhibitory/feedback partner from the REGULATORY_NODES set in energy-neuro-substrate.js (vmPFC, dlPFC, OFC, STN, GP, HIPP, HYPO, dACC, CBLM)? Run against population.json real circuits, matching the JS validateIncompleteCircuit() behavior which reads issue._authored where present, else issue.circuits.
incomplete_circuit_diagnostic._verdict_summary: MIXED: 4 complete / 1 INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT. This is the KEY DIVERGENCE from Energy (6/6 complete) and Finance (6/6 complete). POPULATION_COLLAPSE fails: its circuit [OXY, SEPT, M1, RAPHE, VTA, RSC] contains NO REGULATORY_NODES member. The other 4 issues supply a regulatory partner via their _authored circuits (dlPFC/OFC/HYPO), so those pass. Two issues (MASS_MIGRATION, URBANIZATION_OVERLOAD) have CANONICAL single-node circuits (CeA, THAL) that are bare non-regulatory nodes and WOULD fail canonical-only; two others (AGING_CRISIS, PANDEMIC_DEMOGRAPHIC_SHOCK) have canonical single-nodes (GP, HYPO) that ARE regulatory and would pass even canonical-only.

POPULATION_COLLAPSE.observation: THE ONE FAILURE. Six pure driver/effector/limbic nodes (bonding, family, motor/labor, serotonergic modulation, dopaminergic drive, spatial memory) with no brake (no vmPFC/dlPFC/OFC), no basal-ganglia stop (no STN/GP), no homeostatic feedback (no HIPP/HYPO/dACC), no forward-model (no CBLM). Under Part XIV this is intrinsically dysfunctional: a below-replacement collapse loop with its regulatory arm omitted. Co-points with the NEURODEGENERATION failure-class.

MASS_MIGRATION.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is CeA[Hyper] alone (phasic fear output, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies dlPFC/OFC brakes.

AGING_CRISIS.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is GP[Hyper] alone — GP IS in REGULATORY_NODES (basal-ganglia output gate), so this issue would pass the test even canonical-only.

URBANIZATION_OVERLOAD.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is THAL[Hyper] alone (gating relay, NOT in REGULATORY_NODES) -> would be INCOMPLETE_CIRCUIT if run canonical-only; _authored supplies dlPFC/OFC.

PANDEMIC_DEMOGRAPHIC_SHOCK.observation: Canonical single-node circuit is HYPO[Hyper] alone — HYPO IS in REGULATORY_NODES (homeostatic set-point), so this issue would pass the test even canonical-only.

rows.parameter: Gut serotonin fraction of body total

parameter_table.ratio_preservation_rule: When mapping any neural time constant to a domain equivalent, hold the RATIOS between constants fixed, not just individual values. The ~1000x gap between AP duration (~1 ms) and slow neuromodulatory/hormonal feedback (~seconds-minutes) is the 'fast signal vs slow modulation' invariant; the Population mapping must preserve an analogous fast-action / slow-governance separation (e.g. a real-time census/mortality pulse vs a generational fertility/aging feedback), or the fractal is cosmetic, not structural.
